FROM TB_VIDEO_CONF C LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE E ON C.CRTR_ID = E.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_VIDEO_MOM M ON C.VCONF_ID = M.VCONF_ID AND M.DEL_DT IS NULL LEFT JOIN TB_VIDEO_PTCPT P ON C.VCONF_ID = P.VCONF_ID LEFT JOIN TB_EMPLOYEE PE ON P.EMP_ID = PE.EMP_ID LEFT JOIN TB_DEPARTMENT D ON PE.DEPT_CD = D.DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN TB_JOB_GRADE G ON PE.JOB_GRD_CD = G.JOB_GRD_CD WHERE C.VCONF_ID = #{vconfId}
